performance_claim: Same-session matched comparison on the RX 7900 XTX at 512/128 (Qwen3.8-27B Dense, BF16 KV, persistent session, graph-replay decode, 3 measured runs each): Q4_K_S ties Q4_K_M on decode (34.02 vs 33.99 tok/s shipping AR route; 34.11 vs 34.00 default route) but prefills 38.4% slower on the shipping AR route (602.50 vs 978.70 tok/s; default route 320.15 vs 963.25), while parking more device memory (bytes artifact: resident +0.176 GiB, request peak +2.061 GiB pre-scratch-cap from its dense-BF16 ffn_down/attn_qkv/attn_v tensors). MTP NextN tensor availability is identical: both files carry the same 4 blk.64.nextn tensors.

protocol.shape: prompt 512 / decode 128, max-sequence 768, warmup 1 + measured 3, persistent session, graph-replay decode, compiler cache required
protocol.comparison_basis: back-to-back same-session pairs on an idle card (card0 used 26 MiB at baseline); both members of each pair run the same build and route flag; numbers are not comparable to older topline rows measured on earlier builds

memory_context.note: Q4_K_S stores 8 ffn_down, 3 attn_qkv and 1 attn_v as dense BF16 (1.631 GiB) where Q4_K_M stores Q6_K_T16 layouts; that both raises resident bytes (+0.176 GiB) and routes those tensors through slower prefill dispatch on this build. Request peaks in the bytes artifact predate the 1024-row prefill-scratch cap (2026-09-06), which is geometry-keyed and applies to both quants.

quality.reason: per-quant quality gates are owned by the teacher-gating item (each quant's INT8 vs its same-weight BF16 teacher; no reuse of Q4_K_M/gfx1151 evidence for Q4_K_S/XTX); a KL campaign for Q4_K_S on the XTX is Packet 6 scope, not this comparison

mtp_availability.detail: both GGUFs carry exactly the 4 NextN tensors (0.052 GiB source bytes); the MTP-capable route is available for either quant without file changes

note: Decode parity with a large prefill penalty and higher parked memory means Q4_K_S is not a capacity win on this engine/build: it saves 0.9 GiB of file bytes but costs +0.176 GiB resident, +2.06 GiB pre-cap request peak, and 38.4% prefill on the shipping route. Q4_K_M remains the default.
